gradient: cv2.Sobel ksize3 x/y; native pixel units
sampling: cv2.remap bilinear INTER_LINEAR; native integer coordinates denote pixel centers; BORDER_REFLECT_101
fixed_window_center: frozen parity-checked N3 final native qN
prior_covariance: all222 native candidates weighted covariance C + 1px^2 I, eigenvalues clipped [1px^2,c^2]
prior_center: frozen N3 qN, not uncapped posterior mean
final_cap_center: original BASE q0; once, after joint solve
solver: numpy.linalg.solve, 2x2 SPD; solve against identity for precision, no explicit inverse
fallback: N3 output for invalid covariance/image/SPD; original input for unsupported/sentinel/nonfinite corners; center8 unchanged
temperature: read frozen per-seed existing calibration, never select using DEV

qualitative_selection_rules.good: minimum FG_JOINT_POSTERIOR minus N3_THEN_SUBPIX translation_cm, seed1

runtime: record capture and joint/F wall times; no new whole detector->pose deployment latency benchmark; do not reuse historical sequential latency as joint latency
